content.stem: 以下哪一项是全球性组织在多个司法管辖区管理反金融犯罪(AFC)和制裁合规事务时的关键考虑因素？

options.A: 仅依靠联合国等国际机构来确保制裁合规,因为没有要求遵守当地法律
options.B: 确保集团政策和程序优先遵循美国法规,因为美国法规在全球范围内最具影响力
options.C: 应用全球统一的反金融犯罪和制裁政策,以确保一致性,而无须根据当地法规作出调整
options.D: 确保集团政策符合每个国家具体的反洗钱和制裁法规要求

content.stem_en: Which of the following is a key consideration for a global organization when managing AFC and sanctions compliance across multiple jurisdictions?

options_en.A: Ensuring sanctions compliance by relying solely on international bodies like the UN because there is no requirement to adhere to local laws
options_en.B: Ensuring group policies and procedures prioritize adherence to U.S. regulations because they are the most influential worldwide
options_en.C: Applying global AFC and sanctions policies to ensure consistency without the need to adapt to local regulations
options_en.D: Ensuring group policies cater to compliance with each country's specific AML and sanctions regulations
